kurz: AMW can handle two things for you: how strictly a change is reviewed (review level) and when it reports that something can be released (release rhythm). Both stay off until the lead switches them on.

schritte.text: Settings › Project › Review levels to “on”. From then on every review request starts with its level and the files that decide it.

High – database, sign-in, permissions, file exchange, queue, release – is reviewed by the lead. Medium – interface, help and other code – by an agent other than the builder. Low – docs and tests only – needs no review request.
With the lead's merge approval and a green full run on exactly this commit: `amw release ausliefern --zweig <branch> --aufgabe <nr>`.
The builder can raise a review request: `amw pruefung bitte … --stufe hoch`. Lowering is not possible.

Settings › Project › Release rhythm: immediately, daily at a time, or per milestone. When something is ready – green review, merge approval, full run on exactly this commit – whoever handles merges (otherwise the lead) gets one message. AMW never releases by itself.

werte: off, immediately, daily at HH:MM, per milestone
fehler: The review request went to an agent, the level requires the lead. Ask the lead instead.
AMW could not read the changed files: the project folder is missing or the commit is unknown there. It then counts as high.
It only reports once every open task of the milestone is ready.
